initial_failure: Two concurrent startup workers both charged and launched the same source checkpoint.
fix: Acquire a nonblocking PostgreSQL session advisory lock on tenant/source before charging; retain a dedicated connection through worker exit; close on charge refusal, scheduling failure, normal exit and cancellation, including cancellation before coroutine entry.
concurrency_checks: one launch and one charge across two overlapping startup calls
early task cancellation closes claim before any execute call
limits: Each active resume holds one dedicated database connection, bounded by startup resume concurrency. Database-session loss while a worker survives and cross-process failure injection for the claim itself remain unverified; no general HA fencing claim.
